title: albizia decandra
intro: Albizia decandra, commonly known as Siris, is a flowering plant species in the family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders. The therapeutic actions of Albizia decandra are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, and act as a natural antihistamine. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
